fixtures: Shell sandbox cases. Each setup script (evals/files/<case>.sh, built on evals/files/sandbox.sh) makes a world in the run's directory: Downloads/, the Apple Music auto-import folder and library under Music/Media.localized/, a NAS staging folder NAS/, and the plugin's config.json under config/, which the session's project settings point MEDIA_MGMT_CONFIG_PATH at (every other MEDIA_MGMT_* variable is blanked, so no real path leaks in). Audio is real: short tagged tones made by ffmpeg, zipped the way stores ship them. The evidence (evals/files/evidence.sh) lists every file added, removed or changed since setup, the whole tree, every MP3's tags as ffprobe reads them, config.json, and, for Apple Music, the stub osascript's calls and playlists.

evals.name: stops-at-metadata
evals.prompt: I just bought Night Drive - Afterglow, it's in ./Downloads/ — can you process it end to end?
evals.expected_output: Uses the plugin's skills: identifies the ZIP pair by contents, extracts the MP3 ZIP into its own subfolder Downloads/Night Drive - Afterglow/ (never into Downloads/ itself), inspects the tags, then stops at the mandatory metadata checkpoint: presents track count, artist, album and genre and asks the user to confirm them (genre chosen by the user). Nothing reaches the Apple Music auto-import folder or the NAS; the ZIPs stay in Downloads.
assertions: The evidence shows the 4 MP3s extracted into a subfolder of Downloads (such as Downloads/Night Drive - Afterglow/), with no audio files extracted directly into Downloads/
Stops and asks the user to confirm the metadata (artist, album, genre) before importing
The evidence shows nothing added to the Apple Music auto-import folder
The evidence shows nothing added under NAS/
The evidence shows both original ZIPs still in Downloads/ (not moved or deleted)

evals.name: compilation-question
evals.prompt: process the Summer Sampler I just bought, it's in ./Downloads/. That's the right release, so go ahead and extract it and check the tags.
evals.expected_output: Finds the Summer Sampler ZIP pair (named after every artist), extracts the MP3s into a subfolder, inspects them, sees four different artists, and at the metadata checkpoint asks whether it is a compilation, proposing Album Artist 'Various Artists' with the compilation flag. Nothing is imported or archived yet.
assertions: Notes that the tracks have four different artists
Asks whether it is a compilation (or proposes Album Artist 'Various Artists' with the compilation flag) and waits for the user's answer
The evidence shows nothing added to the Apple Music auto-import folder or under NAS/
The evidence shows no MP3 tags changed yet (no album_artist or compilation set before the user answers)

evals.name: preconfirmed-stops-at-import-check
evals.prompt: Process Night Drive - Afterglow from ./Downloads/. I've already checked the tags: genre Electronic, artist Night Drive, album Afterglow, single-artist album — that's all confirmed, go ahead and import it.
evals.expected_output: Treats the metadata as confirmed: extracts the MP3s into a subfolder, applies the confirmed metadata (genre Electronic, Album Artist cleared, tracks numbered n/4), copies the 4 MP3s (and no WAV) into the auto-import folder, then stops at the mandatory Apple Music check: asks the user to verify the import before anything is archived. Nothing is staged on the NAS and the ZIPs stay in Downloads.
assertions: The evidence shows the 4 MP3s added to the Apple Music auto-import folder, with genre Electronic
No WAV file was added to the auto-import folder
The evidence shows the imported MP3s numbered 1/4 to 4/4
Stops and asks the user to check the import in Apple Music before archiving
The evidence shows nothing added under NAS/ and both ZIPs still in Downloads/
